tiers.name: Easy
quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
other: Within the Light (not required, but recommended for Temple of Light teleport)
items: Arrows, any type from bronze to dragon not including Broad arrows[IR 1]
Bow that uses arrows[IR 1]
New key (not needed if Within the Light completed)
Plank (optional to cross over Underground Pass traps safely)
Runes for casting any Shadow Spell, plus a magic weapon to cast with
Dramen staff or Lunar staff (if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift is not completed)
Crystal trinket (if entering Temple of Light from the Mourner HQ)
Ardougne teleport method or 'Chipped' Ardougne teleport (recommended)
^ a b c If traversing the Underground Pass from the West Ardougne entrance

tasks.name: Iban You from Hurting Me!
tasks.desc: Kill a disciple of Iban while using Iban's staff.
tasks.notes:
Kill a disciple of Iban while using Iban's staff. The staff only needs to be equipped when the disciple dies, it does not have to be used to kill the disciple.
Attacking with Iban's staff can be done by casting magic basic attack, or by using the Weapon Special Attack ability located in the Constitution book.

tasks.name: Driven, Underground
tasks.desc: Navigate the Underground Pass, using the thieving shortcuts and talking to Klank on the way through about his gloves. (X/2)
tasks.notes: Navigate the Underground Pass, using the thieving shortcuts and talking to Klank on the way through about his gauntlets.

tasks.name: Arandar-bout Way
tasks.desc: Enter through the gates of the Arandar Pass while wearing only a full mourner outfit.
tasks.notes:
Enter through the gates of the Arandar Pass while wearing only a full set of mourner gear.
Only the mourner gear must be worn with all other equipment slots empty. Overrides and (active) auras are allowed to be worn on this achievement. After completing the Plague's End quest, the mourner gear can be re-obtained in a chest from the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne. The chest is in the room which was previously where the head mourner was. Using the Sixth-Age circuit's teleport to the World Gate option will bring the player a few steps away from the gate.

tasks.name: Blowing Your Own Trumpet
tasks.desc: Get Gwir in Lletya to remind you about your previous adventures in the elven lands.
tasks.notes:
Get Gwir in Lletya to remind the player about their previous adventures in the elven lands. Gwir is the scribe who can be found north of the bank in Lletya.
If the player has not previously told Gwir about their adventures, then players will need to go through the dialogue first and then ask about their previous adventures.

tasks.name: The Motherlode
tasks.desc: Use the Tirannwn lodestone.
tasks.notes: Use the Home Teleport spell to teleport to the Tirannwn lodestone.

tasks.name: Tyrassed to Impress
tasks.desc: Equip a Tyras helm inside Tyras Camp.
tasks.notes:
Equip a Tyras helm inside the Tyras Camp.
A Tyras helm can be bought at any Trader Crewmember. There is one in Port Tyras. It will only trigger if you equip it while inside the camp, not wearing it into the camp.

tasks.name: Lime Ordeal
tasks.desc: Mine limestone at the mountains of Arandar.
tasks.notes: Mine limestone at the Arandar Pass mine, just south-east of Prifddinas.

tasks.name: Leaf Me Alone
tasks.desc: Attempt to pass a leaf trap.
tasks.notes: Attempt to pass a leaf trap in the Isafdar forest. The attempt does not need to be successful.

tasks.name: Fairy Liquid
tasks.desc: Teleport to the fairy ring in the Poison Waste.
quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
tasks.notes:
Teleport to the fairy ring with code DLR in the Poison Waste.
The player will require a Lunar staff or dramen staff, unless A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed.

tasks.name: Stand Still, Eluned!
tasks.desc: Have Eluned or Ilfeen recharge a teleport crystal for you in Isafdar.
tasks.notes:
Have Eluned or Ilfeen recharge a crystal teleport seed in the Isafdar forest.
Right-clicking Eluned to recharge does complete the achievement. Selecting the seed and using it on Eluned does not complete the achievement. Recharging a crystal with Ilfeen will also work, but Eluned in Prifddinas will not. Selecting the seed and using it on Ilfeen does work.
The location of Ilfeen is dependent on progress in The Prisoner of Glouphrie quest, if it is completed then one needs to visit Ilfeen in Lletya.
Contacting Islwyn through the NPC Contact spell no longer works for the achievement, but this method can be used to recharge the seed.

tasks.name: Casting Shadows
tasks.desc: Kill a shadow in the Temple of Light with a shadow spell.
tasks.notes:
Kill a shadow in the Temple of Light with a shadow spell. Earth runes and either death runes or blood runes, as well as a magic weapon are required to complete this achievement.
Shadow spells are one of five types of Ancient Magicks combat spells. An ability will not work; the runes must be spent to cast the spell and kill the shadow with a regular auto-attack to get credit for the achievement.
The shadows in Prifddinas do not work for this achievement.

tasks.name: Sick and Twisted
tasks.desc: Kill a warped terrorbird or tortoise in the Warped Poison Waste Dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Kill a warped terrorbird or tortoise in the Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon. A crystal chime is required to kill the warped creatures, the one on the tool belt works.
The spirit tree Incomitatus is closest to access the dungeon. Players can also run west from Castle Wars, but will need a crossbow and a mithril grapple, or alternatively an enhanced grappling hook on the tool belt, to cross a gap to reach the dungeon. The three warped terrorbirds killed during The Path of Glouphrie quest do not count for this achievement.

reward.intro:
Talk to the Elf Tracker, who is located east of the Tirannwn lodestone, to claim the rewards for the easy achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: An antique lamp granting 10,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 47 or higher)
Tirannwn quiver 1, which grants the following bonuses:
perks: Up to 20,000 of any ammunition slot items can be stored for use when ranging with relevant weapons. Upon death, the quiver appears in gravestones or Death's item reclaim with a reclaim value equal to the ammo stored. If skulled, the quiver is lost and the ammo is dropped.
No longer fall in leaf traps
5% of tortoise shells dropped by warped tortoises will be noted
Acts as a crystal chime against warped monsters
Can use the elven crystal inside the Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon to teleport to the end of the dungeon
Unlimited teleport to: Lletya, and to Eluned, wherever she is on the Isafdar forest or Prifddinas, or Islwyn if Eluned is unavailable (after The Light Within)
Limestone can be sold to Meredith
The Lletya General Store offers 15 swamp tar per day
Damage increased by 5% against mourners in the Mourner HQ in West Ardougne. Also works on the Knights of Ardougne that replace them after Plague's End.

tiers.name: Medium
other: Started A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen or Plague's End to hop onto Poison Waste island
items: Papaya tree seed (or grown tree)
Plant pot (if the player does not have a grown Papaya tree)
Death talisman or death tiara (or a wicked hood with death activated)

tasks.name: Harrowed Lands
tasks.desc: Make harralander tar in the Poison Waste using tar sourced in Tirannwn. (X/2)
tasks.notes: Make harralander tar in the Poison Waste using swamp tar sourced in Tirannwn. The Tirannwn quiver 1 must be claimed before this achievement can be completed.

tasks.name: Bowing Out and About
tasks.desc: Create a yew longbow from scratch in the elven lands. (X/5)
tasks.notes: Create a yew longbow from scratch in Tirannwn. Yew trees in Isafdar or Prifddinas work, including any yew tree grown by the player in Trahaearn district.

tasks.name: An Act of War
tasks.desc: Purchase a halberd from the Tyras Camp, then use it to kill an elf in the Elf Camp. (X/2)
tasks.notes: Purchase a halberd from the Tyras Camp and use it to kill an elf warrior in the Elf Camp south of Prifddinas.

tasks.name: Sharks are Good for the Elf
tasks.desc: Bank a shark fished from the elven lands using the Elf Camp deposit box. (X/2)
tasks.notes: Bank a raw shark fished in Tirannwn using the deposit chest in Elf Camp. The deposit chest is unlocked after completing the Deadliest Catch quest.

tasks.name: Gnome Roaming
tasks.desc: Exit Tirannwn through the Galarpos Mountains.
tasks.notes: Exit Tirannwn and navigate through the Galarpos Mountains.

tasks.name: Mufflebirds
tasks.desc: Attempt to pass a poison bolt tripwire trap.
tasks.notes: Attempt to pass a tripwire in the Isafdar forest in Tirannwn.

tasks.name: The Circle of Life
tasks.desc: Use Pawya meat in a grenwall trap.
tasks.notes:
Use pawya meat in a grenwall trap. The pawya meat needs to be used on a box trap in a Hunter area in Isafdar. A grenwall does not need to be caught for the achievement to complete.
A convenient Hunter area with both pawyas and grenwalls is located west of the Tirannwn lodestone, past the dense forest obstacle. It may be faster to trap the pawya at the magic trees (exit Lletya and head south), since there are no predatory grenwalls to kill them. The players need papaya fruit as a bait to trap the pawya.
Any Hunter area outside Isafdar, such as the Gorajo resource dungeon and Nyriki's private hunting grounds, will not work.

tasks.name: Papa Pawya
tasks.desc: Trap a pawya in the elven lands using a papaya you have harvested from a tree grown in the elven lands.
tasks.notes:
Trap a pawya in Tirannwn using a papaya that was harvested by the player from a player grown papaya tree at the Lletya or Prifddinas fruit tree patch.
The optional protection by the elven farmer Amaethwr for a papaya tree requires 10 pineapples as a payment. If the farmer is not paid to protect the patch then it is possible the patch could be diseased. It is also possible to fail to catch a pawya, so multiple papayas may be required. A convenient Hunter area with both pawyas and grenwalls is located west of the Tirannwn lodestone, past the dense forest obstacle.

tasks.name: Pretty and Witty and Dead
tasks.desc: Create death runes from at least 20 pure essence whilst wearing a death tiara at the Death Altar.
tasks.notes:
Create death runes from at least 20 pure essences whilst wearing a death tiara at the death altar.
Alternatively, an omni-tiara may be used instead of the death tiara. Wearing a wicked hood that has been fed a death talisman will work as a substitute for completing the achievement. An ethereal hood will not count as a death tiara, however it can still be used as a substitute for the wicked hood. There needs to be 20 pure essences in the backpack. Having pure essence only in essence pouches will not work. The pure essence withdrawn from a pouch will work, but the pure essence needs to be withdrawn by emptying the pouch, not by automatically crafting the contents of the pouch.

tasks.name: Light Transit
tasks.desc: Enter the Temple of Light using a teleport crystal.
tasks.notes:
Enter the Temple of Light using a crystal teleport seed or attuned crystal teleport seed.
The ability to teleport to the Temple of Light is added by talking to Eluned after the Within the Light quest with a crystal teleport seed of 8 charges in the player's inventory. Although she will recharge the teleport seed at any of her locations, she only gives the added teleport option if spoken to in one of her two locations in Isafdar. These are east of the Tyras Camp and west of Lletya. The Temple of Light teleport will not be added when speaking to Eluned in Prifddinas, you must find her in the forest. Players can quickly get to Eluned by using the teleport option on the Tirannwn quiver 1.
If The Light Within is already completed, then speak with Islwyn in the Ithell Clan district of Prifddinas.

tasks.name: Stranger and Stranger
tasks.desc: Create a stranger plant pouch at the Well of Voyage.
tasks.notes:
Create a stranger plant pouch at the obelisk near the Well of Voyage which requires 1 crimson charm, 1 bagged plant 1, 128 spirit shards, and a pouch.
If the Fang of Mohegan is owned, the teleport is useful to teleport directly to the obelisk. Create the pouch at the obelisk located in the cave north of Lletya marked as a Summoning and dungeon entrance icon on the (mini) map.

reward.intro:
If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to Gwir, who is located in eastern Lletya (located in the room north of the bank), to claim the rewards for the medium achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: An antique lamp granting 30,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 68 or higher)
Tirannwn quiver 2, which, in addition to Tirannwn quiver 1's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:
perks: No longer fail tripwires
Additional unlimited teleport locations: Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon and Tyras Camp

Access to the mushroom patch between the Tyras Camp and the Poison Waste. This patch cannot be protected from disease (and does not benefit from the medium Morytania achievements disease-free mushroom patch reward), but will give double harvest if elite Morytania achievements are completed.
The Lletya General Store offers 30 swamp tar per day
Grenwalls no longer require bait
Chance of not using charges of a crystal bow
Damage increased by 5% against shadow creatures in Prifddinas

tiers.name: Hard
items: Moss titan, ice titan or fire titan pouch
A summoning pouch of some sort

tasks.name: Sing-Along-a-Seren Verse 1
tasks.desc: During the Amlodd Voice of Seren : create a Titan's Constitution summoning scroll.
tasks.notes: Create a Elemental Titan scroll (Titan's Constitution) when the Amlodd Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren. Either a moss titan pouch, ice titan pouch, or fire titan pouch is required to make this scroll and converting the pouch into scrolls needs to be done at the obelisk in the Amlodd Clan district in order to complete this achievement. No other obelisk will work.

tasks.name: Sing-Along-a-Seren Verse 2
tasks.desc: During the Cadarn Voice of Seren : use a crystal bow to damage a Cadarn elf.
tasks.notes: Use a crystal bow or attuned crystal bow to damage either a Cadarn magus or Cadarn ranger with an auto-attack when the Cadarn Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren. Using abilities to damage a Cadarn warrior will not count for this achievement. Having arrows or arrows in a quiver equipped or in the backpack may prevent the achievement from unlocking.

tasks.name: Sing-Along-a-Seren Verse 3
tasks.desc: During the Crwys Voice of Seren : cut a magic log in the Crwys district.
tasks.notes:
Cut a magic log in the Crwys Clan district in Prifddinas when the Crwys Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren.
The magic trees are in the four corners of the bridge area between the Crwys Clan district and the Cadarn Clan district.

tasks.name: Sing-Along-a-Seren Verse 4
tasks.desc: During the Hefin Voice of Seren : complete one lap of the Hefin Agility Course successfully.
tasks.notes: Complete one lap of the Hefin Agility Course successfully when the Hefin Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren.

tasks.name: Sing-Along-a-Seren Verse 5
tasks.desc: During the Iorwerth Voice of Seren : use a crystal dagger to damage an Iorwerth elf.
tasks.notes:
Use a crystal dagger or its off-hand version to damage an Iorwerth guard or Iorwerth scout while the Iorwerth Voice of Seren is active.
Alternatively an attuned crystal dagger and its off-hand version work as well. The Iorwerth warrior must be attacked with an auto-attack, not an ability for the achievement to be completed. The elf must be inside the Iorwerth Clan district, the main streets do not count.

tasks.name: Sing-Along-a-Seren Verse 6
tasks.desc: During the Meilyr Voice of Seren : craft a perfect juju farming potion using moss you harvested yourself.
other: 74 Hunter Hunter (b) (to obtain the Juju farming potion used in making its perfect variant)
tasks.notes: Craft a perfect juju farming potion by using a juju farming potion (3) with harmony moss which was harvested by the player when the Meilyr Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren. Both steps need to be completed while the Voice of Seren is active there. In addition, the potion must be mixed while the player is in the Meilyr district; the achievement will not be completed if the potion is mixed elsewhere.

tasks.name: Sing-Along-a-Seren Verse 7
tasks.desc: During the Trahaearn Voice of Seren : mine an adamantite or runite rock.
tasks.notes:
Mine an adamantite rock or runite rock at the Trahaearn Clan district when that district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren.
Do not wear a sign of the porter, the auto banking feature will prevent the game from registering the mined ore and because of that the achievement cannot be completed.

tasks.name: What a Rush
tasks.desc: Play a non-reward game of Rush of Blood.
tasks.notes:
Play a non-reward game of Rush of Blood.
An easy way to finish this achievement is to equip no items, begin a trial run, and let the monsters kill the player. Exiting the dungeon while the timer is running will not count.

tasks.name: The Diplomatic Approach
tasks.desc: Find and speak to the elf lords and ladies from each of the eight clans inside the walls of Prifddinas. (X/8)
tasks.notes: Find and speak to the elf lords and ladies from each of the eight Elven Clans inside the walls of Prifddinas until the first chat options appear. They can be found in their respective clan districts. A crystal teleport seed, an attuned crystal teleport seed, or the Master camouflage outfit can be used to teleport to each district to speed things up.

tasks.name: Hefin And Puffin'
tasks.desc: Take a shortcut on the Hefin Agility Course.
tasks.notes:
Take a shortcut on the Hefin Agility Course in Prifddinas.
A green message will appear in the chatbox when the shortcut is available.

tasks.name: Long Way From Home
tasks.desc: Complete the Hefin Agility course with a light creature familiar summoned.
tasks.notes:
Complete the Hefin Agility Course with a light creature familiar summoned and pet overrides turned off. The Summoning level cannot be boosted.
There is currently a bug that prevents players from getting credit for the achievement if they completed the course with a Hefin course multiplier in the backpack. Complete the course again without any multipliers in the backpack to complete the achievement. Velocity activating on any obstacle will also prevent players from getting credit for the achievement.
Players will still get the achievement if they summon the familiar right before the final obstacle, merging with the light creature.

tasks.name: Because You're Iorwerth It
tasks.desc: Defeat an Iorwerth warrior while under the influence of the Iorwerth prayer altar.
tasks.notes:
Defeat an Iorwerth scout or Iorwerth guard while under the influence of the prayer altar in the mansion in the Iorwerth Clan district in Prifddinas by praying at that altar.
Leaving the room will nullify the progress of completing this achievement.

tasks.name: Cadarn Tootin'
tasks.desc: Swap to the Ancient spellbook at the Cadarn grimoire, then defeat a Cadarn elf whilst using the Ancient spellbook.
tasks.notes: Swap to the Ancient Magicks spellbook at the elven grimoire in the Cadarn district and then defeat a Cadarn magus or Cadarn ranger. The elf does not need to be killed with Magic.

tasks.name: A Face in the Clouds
tasks.desc: Bring a mound of bacon, bread and a chocolate bar to Seren.
tasks.notes: Bring bacon mound, bread, and a chocolate bar to Seren, who is located upstairs in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas, and use one of the items on Seren.

tasks.name: Brace for Additional Impact
tasks.desc: Wear a bracelet of clay while mining soft clay in the Ithell district of Prifddinas.
tasks.notes:
Wear a bracelet of clay while mining soft clay in the Ithell Clan district of Prifddinas.
A bracelet of clay can be bought from the Grand Exchange for 1,117.

tasks.name: Thank You, Deer
tasks.desc: Exchange a familiar pouch for shards with Lord Amlodd.
tasks.notes:
Exchange a familiar pouch for spirit shards with Lord Amlodd.
The player needs to have a Summoning level higher than the level that is required to create the pouch, see Bogrog for the exact details.
Swapping scrolls also work. It is not known if this is a bug.

tasks.name: Disco Impling
tasks.desc: Do a dance in the impling collector's house with at least ten other implings present.
tasks.notes:
Use the dance emote in Daffyd's house in the Amlodd Clan district of Prifddinas after 10 or more different types of implings have been caught.
The Impetuous Impulses minigame has a large variety of implings to catch, so it's an ideal location for catching 10 different kinds of implings for this achievement. It is also possible to obtain implings (in a jar) from Motherlode Maw or in the Gorajo resource dungeon.

tasks.name: Can I Have Some Morvran?
tasks.desc: Complete a Morvran slayer assignment that has been both preferred and extended.
tasks.notes:
Complete a slayer assignment that was assigned by Morvran and has been both preferred and extended.
The assigned task does not have to be on the preferred list prior to assignment. A task can be received (or forced by using a monster specific slayer mask/helm), then preferred by spending 100 slayer points. This will also extend the assignment. To access preferred assignment and extension on the assignment, right click Morvran for rewards and select the tab for assignments.

tasks.name: B Sharp, Not Flat
tasks.desc: Play and retune each of the harps in the Ithell Harmonium.
tasks.notes: Play and retune each of the four harps in the Ithell Harmonium.

tasks.name: Casting a Shadow
tasks.desc: Throw a blissful shadow core into the Amlodd crater.
tasks.notes:
Convert a blissful shadow core at the light rift located in the Amlodd Clan district of Prifddinas.
Blissful shadows in the Amlodd Clan district must be killed until one drops a blissful shadow core.

tasks.name: A Clean Slate
tasks.desc: Cleanse the Corrupted Seren Stone with at least one crystal.
tasks.notes:
Cleanse the corrupted Seren Stone with at least one cleansing crystal.
This requires purchase of a cleansing crystal for 110,000 coins; alternatively the cleansing crystal can rarely be received from pickpocketing Hefin workers, or when cutting crystal trees with a crystal hatchet.

Teleport to the Death Altar 5 times per day
Lord Amlodd's shard swap gives 10% more shards
Eilwynn will take chronicle fragments, granting 75% of the experience of Guthix's shrine
Lunet will sell 16 battlestaves
Damage increased by 5% against elves in Prifddinas

At least one skill at level 99, or the Quest Cape

tasks.name: Robot of Sherwood
tasks.desc: Pickpocket a Trahaearn elf while wearing the Trahaearn exoskeleton set.
tasks.notes: Pickpocket a Trahaearn worker while wearing the Trahaearn exoskeleton set.

tasks.name: The Crested Guest is Best
tasks.desc: Visit Seren and bow or curtsy whilst wearing the Crest of Seren.
tasks.notes: Visit Seren in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas, and bow or curtsy whilst wearing the Crest of Seren override. Do not confuse the Crest of Seren override with Seren's symbol or with the Crest of Seren from the Heart of Gielinor.

tasks.name: Ace of Dungeons
tasks.desc: Talk to the gorajo hoardstalker while under the influence of a perfect dungeoneering juju potion.
tasks.notes: Talk to the gorajo hoardstalker while under the influence of a perfect juju dungeoneering potion.

tasks.name: Weave Come a Long Way
tasks.desc: Make a level 90 milestone cape using a loom in Prifddinas.
tasks.notes:
Make a level 90 milestone cape using a loom in Prifddinas which requires 9 balls of wool.
The loom can be found in the eastern Cadarn Clan district. Making a level 90 milestone cape requires all skills to be at least level 90. Invention does not count towards this achievement as it is an elite skill. You cannot use skill boosts to make the cape.

tasks.name: Properly Metal
tasks.desc: Clear wave 15 in a Gold or Platinum wave of the Rush of Blood D&D.
other:
One of:
• 99 Slayer Slayer (Platinum) or
• Blood Runs Deep (Gold)
tasks.notes: Clear wave 15 of the Rush of Blood Distraction and Diversion on either the gold or platinum difficulty. Wave 15 must be completed, which means that wave 16 needs to start before the timer runs out to complete this achievement. The run can be done as a trial or a reward run.

tasks.name: Respect your Elders
tasks.desc: Chop a log from an elder tree you have grown in the Prifddinas farming patch, then fletch it into a shortbow. (X/2)
tasks.notes: Chop a log from an elder tree which they have grown in the elder tree patch in Prifddinas, then fletch it into an elder shortbow (unstrung). The bow does not need to be strung to complete the achievement.

tasks.name: Xena-Phile
tasks.desc: Sing an attuned crystal weapon from an attuned seed in the Ithell area of Prifddinas.
tasks.notes:
Sing an attuned crystal weapon from an attuned crystal weapon seed in the Ithell Clan district of Prifddinas which requires at least 1,000 harmonic dust in addition to the seed.
Lady Ithell gives one free attuned crystal weapon seed to a player as long as a player does not own one or any attuned crystal weapon and if the player has not dropped anything in the past 10 minutes. This includes the player's inventory, bank and Lady Ithell's storage. Players may revert existing attuned crystal weapons and sing them into a weapon again. If players choose to destroy the seed once received from Lady Ithell, they can receive another one the following week, but only while the achievement has not been completed yet. The player must have the required skills for Lady Ithell to offer the free seed (not boostable). Singing an attuned crystal armour seed will also complete the achievement, and you will not be able to claim the weapon seed if this is done beforehand.

tasks.name: The Expensive Range
tasks.desc: Create a grand ranging potion in a crystal flask from nothing but raw ingredients, performing each step within Prifddinas. (X/4)
tasks.notes:
Create a grand ranging potion in a crystal flask from nothing but herblore ingredients, performing each step within Prifddinas.
The following steps yield task completion:
• Mine crystal-flecked sandstone. It must be mined in the Ithell district; the rock in the Edimmu resource dungeon will not work.
• Blow it into crystal glass.
• Blow it into crystal flask.
• Combine the super ranging potion (4) and ranging potion (4) into the crystal flask to produce a grand ranging potion (requires purchasing the recipe from Lady Meilyr for 100,000 coins).

Ability to fast travel through Tirannwn dense forests

Double crystal tree blossoms harvested from a player-grown crystal tree
Damage increased by 5% against dark beasts
The ability to see Mune in Tirannwn on Tuesdays and sometimes on Saturdays and/or Sundays if all Tirannwn achievements have been completed and all the rewards have been claimed
